scope.rule: Curate parent archetypes whose first foundation route is Scout; class route is batching context only and never owns identity.

policy.primary: Defining identity signals: a character strongly matching the archetype should normally express several of these.
policy.supporting: Strongly characteristic secondary signals; helpful evidence but not required.
policy.narrativeAndMechanicsRequired: Tags must be supported by narrative identity, curated Phase 0-11 mechanics, exact recommendations, or a combination; do not union every referenced rules tag.
policy.forceRule: Optional Force access does not make force/force_power/force_training defining archetype tags.

fringer.name: Fringer
fringer.rationale: The galactic-edge survivor fantasy centers on exploration, perception, survival and self-reliance. Repair/improvisation, endurance, mobility and piloting are characteristic tools, not universal requirements.

evidence.narrative: Survivor of the galactic edge; improvises, repairs, navigates local dangers and gets by without reliable institutions.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.rationale: Scavenger identity is about turning discarded material into useful machinery and resources. Mechanics, equipment, crafting/modification and tech are defining; perception, repair and survival enable the work.

evidence.narrative: Makes a living turning refuse into food, shelter, credits or machinery; sees value where others see trash.
talents: Starships of the Galaxy|Outlaw Tech|Personalized Modifications

bounty_hunter.name: Bounty Hunter
bounty_hunter.rationale: The parent identity is a professional quarry-finder first, not a specific weapon build. Tracking, pursuit, investigation, perception and survival define the hunt; ranged precision, target acquisition and information work support it.

evidence.narrative: Professional predator who turns wanted beings into contracts; hunting combines investigation, preparation, travel, patience and confrontation.

sector_ranger.name: Sector Ranger
sector_ranger.rationale: Sector Ranger is a roaming interjurisdictional lawman/detective. Investigation and pursuit are the core identity; wilderness competence, piloting and nonlethal/control-oriented enforcement support the roaming-lawman fantasy.

evidence.narrative: Roaming galactic lawman pursuing criminals across planetary jurisdictions; part frontier marshal, federal investigator, pilot and lone-traveler detective.
talents: Clone Wars Campaign Guide|Vanguard|Soften the Target

frontier_marshal.name: Frontier Marshal
frontier_marshal.rationale: The marshal is local authority and protector. Leadership, persuasion, awareness and enabling allies define the role; investigation, frontier competence and tactical coordination are secondary expressions.

evidence.narrative: The law in one bad place; protects a settlement or frontier community where authority may be one office and whoever is brave enough to help.
talents: Saga Edition Core Rulebook|Military Tactics|Assault Tactics

force_hunter.name: Force Hunter
force_hunter.rationale: Force Hunter studies Force-users as prey. Anti-Force counterplay is defining, but Force sensitivity is optional, so generic force/force_power/force_training tags are intentionally excluded from the identity profile.

evidence.narrative: Specialist who studies Force-users as prey; may be Imperial, mercenary, Sith-aligned, traumatized survivor or former Jedi.
talents: Legacy Era Campaign Guide|Force Hunter|Telekinetic Resistance
Saga Edition Core Rulebook|Bounty Hunter|Hunter's Mark

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.rationale: Sniper identity is deliberate ranged precision from advantageous/hidden positions. Perception and stealth support target selection; setup, ambush, concealment and critical-hit specialization describe the method without locking the archetype to a specific firearm category.

saboteur.name: Saboteur
saboteur.rationale: Saboteur is covert technical disruption. Mechanics, stealth, tech, infiltration and engineered hazards are defining. Demolition, equipment, setup and reliability come directly from the curated Sabotage/Skilled Demolitionist material.

talents: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Infiltration|Concealed Weapon Expert

partisan.name: Partisan
partisan.rationale: Partisan identity is irregular warfare under occupation: concealment, survival, ambushes, covert movement and coercive disruption. Revolutionary rhetoric and reconnaissance add social/control and teamwork dimensions without making the archetype a formal commander.

evidence.narrative: Irregular fighter in occupied territory using ambushes, sabotage, safehouses, local support, homemade weapons and fear of collaborators.
talents: Clone Wars Campaign Guide|Reconnaissance|Reconnaissance Team Leader

pilot.name: Pilot
pilot.rationale: Pilot identity is vehicle/space operation and maneuver. Pursuit and mobility distinguish piloting from generic vehicle familiarity; Wingman/Squadron material supports tactics, teamwork and support without making combat mandatory.

talents: Saga Edition Core Rulebook|Expert Pilot|Relentless Pursuit
Starships of the Galaxy|Squadron Leader|Squadron Maneuvers
